MRI Safety Information
The Cobalt Transcatheter Valve is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5T only when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Spatial field gradient: ≤ 3 T/m (300 gauss/cm).
- Scan in First Level Controlled Operating Mode.
- Use CP mode only (circularly polarized RF excitation).
- Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg.
- Scan for up to 60 minutes.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
